entities.summary: Fleeing Napoleon, a notable figure in the history of Brazil, associated with The Portuguese Court in Brazil and Independence (1808–1821). Preceded by United Kingdom and Portuguese royal court arrives in Rio de Janeiro — March 1808. Their legacy influenced Brazil elevated to Kingdom status and Pedro I abdicates — April 7, 1831.
